title: Mobility Equipment Warranty Claims Desk Card — Drive Motor and Gearbox Replacements
content:
# Drive Motor and Gearbox Replacements Under the Manufacturer's Warranty — Mobility Equipment

**Scope.** A completed drive motor and gearbox replacement on a Mobility Equipment power chair that the chair manufacturer's motor warranty pays for is posted as one repair job on the wheelchair record its repair request belongs to. The job carries the labor Summit Ridge claims from the manufacturer for the replacement, in whole 15-minute units.

**Business effect.** Each posting adds one motor and gearbox repair job under the manufacturer's warranty to the chair's service history, dated the day its completed repair request was completed, with the drive motor and gearbox as the component repaired and the manufacturer's warranty as the party bearing the cost. The job carries the labor units claimed, no parts cost (the drive unit is supplied by the manufacturer), no patient share, the loaner flag given and the chair's serial number copied from its record. It appears in the chair's service history returned by the wheelchair service lookup, and nothing is charged to the patient.

## Invocation of `record_drive_warranty_job_9fda7dd9`

This is an agent-side tool: the agent unlocks `record_drive_warranty_job_9fda7dd9` and then calls it. One call posts one job.

| Parameter | What it is | Format and values |
|---|---|---|
| `mobility_holding_id` | the reference number of the patient's wheelchair record the job was done on, as returned by the wheelchair record lookup for this patient | identifier |
| `mobility_request_id` | the reference number of the completed repair request for this job, as returned by the wheelchair request lookup for the patient's chair | identifier |
| `labor_units` | the labor claimed for the job, in whole 15-minute units | non-negative integer, no decimals; one unit is 15 minutes of labor |
| `loaner_issued` | whether a loaner chair was out with the patient for this job | `true` when the chair's service history shows a loaner chair delivered for the time the chair was in for this repair; `false` when no loaner chair was delivered for this repair |

**Receipt.** A confirmation sentence carrying the new repair job reference (starting `msv_`), the wheelchair record reference it was posted on, the job date (YYYY-MM-DD) and the labor units booked (integer). Receiving the sentence with a job reference means the job is posted.

## Hypothetical input and receipt

A motor replacement whose repair request was completed on 3 September, posted at a whole number of units with `loaner_issued` set to `false`, returns a sentence naming a new job reference beginning `msv_`, the wheelchair record, the date 2025-09-03 and the units booked.
